decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family that survived the early post-launch pruning and sits close to the firm's core hardware business, management is likely to stay committed and interpret any weaker performance as temporary.
This door handle design remained marketed beyond launch, and in a large German metal-products firm such visible design investments are typically defended rather than quickly withdrawn.

The electronic access system appears to have required substantial development and was promoted publicly as a distinctive innovation, so escalation of commitment makes management likely to continue backing it despite possible uncertainty in results.
